subject: general
question: Who among the following claimed gold in the 64 kg category of the 35th edition of the Senior Women's National Weightlifting Championships at Khudiram Anushilan Kendra in Kolkata?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Rakhi Halder.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Rakhi Halder is related to weightlifting.
 
• She claimed gold in the 64 kg category of the 35th edition of the** Senior Women's National Weightlifting Championships at Khudiram Anushilan Kendra in Kolkata.**
 
• She created two new National records by clinching a Bronze medal in the women's 64kg category at the Qatar International Cup in Doha.
 
• The Commonwealth Championship gold medallist superseded the senior national record in both snatch and total lift with her personal best effort of .218kg, 95kg, in the snatch with 123kg in clean.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **K. Roshilata Devi** of Manipur in action in the 64Kg U-21 Weightlifting event at Khelo India Youth Games 2019.
 
• **Veerjeet Kaur,** who originally hails from Rori village in Sirsa district in Haryana, becomes U-21 champion in the 49 Kg girls' at Khelo India Youth Games.
 
• **Harjinder Kaur** is an Indian weightlifter.
 
 
• She won the bronze medal at the 2022 Commonwealth Games.
 
• She also won the silver medal in 2021 Commonwealth Youth Games in 71 kg weight category.
